name: write-prd
description: Use to turn a raw feature idea into a reviewed PRD.md — a lightweight Socratic interview front (capture the idea, deep-dive the problem) merged with a full product spec (context, goals, user stories, acceptance criteria, NFRs, KPIs). Triggers on "/sdlc:write-prd {slug}", "write PRD for {slug}", "draft PRD for {slug}", "PRD для {slug}", "write spec for {slug}", "product requirements for {slug}", "напиши PRD {slug}", "опиши вимоги", "зафіксуй ідею". Opens by setting the interview-depth dial (easy/medium/hard), drafts from templates/PRD-template.md, validates each acceptance criterion Socratically, runs a clean-context critic (sdlc:critic), then writes docs/features/{slug}/PRD.md. Hard refuse if idea-brief.md or CONTEXT.md missing.
